hypothesis: DetailDialog renders sub_items using Table with TableCell defaulting to whitespace-nowrap and lacking flex/word-break constraints, causing long titles or descriptions to blow out horizontal layout, push external link buttons beyond the screen boundary, and truncate critical user text.
SubItem link opens via openExternalLink. If user supplies a javascript: or unsafe URL payload, it could execute arbitrary script unless openExternalLink strictly filters protocols.
Clicking on sub_item row or external link button in DetailDialog could propagate up to parent card container, triggering map focusing or unintended card selection.
